scripts.//lint:repo: Files outside every workspace, which `turbo run lint` cannot reach — including the CI guardrail scripts themselves.
scripts.//checks: Structural invariants a linter cannot express. This repo has no CI, so NOTHING RUNS THESE FOR YOU - run `pnpm checks` before a release and after anything that moves the repo's shape. Run `pnpm build` first if you want check-package-files to verify dist/ targets rather than skip them.
scripts.checks: node scripts/check-workspace-scripts.mjs && node scripts/check-package-files.mjs && node scripts/check-repo-hygiene.mjs && node scripts/db/check-migration-drift.mjs
scripts.//hygiene: Just the repo-shape half of `pnpm checks`: lockfiles, orphan workspaces, Node version alignment, the pnpm pin.
scripts.//audit:ci: Dependency advisory gate. Fails on any untriaged high/critical, and on a triage entry that expired or no longer matches. See scripts/audit-allowlist.json.
